design_description: A bold, aggressive pool and billiards jersey for Shasta La Vista, combining a deep black base with striking red and white accents. The front features a dramatic red city skyline, sharp diagonal graphic elements, and the team name in expressive brushstroke typography. A black 8-ball adds a distinctive billiards reference, while red shoulder stripes, sleeve trims, and collar detailing complete the athletic look. The back showcases a powerful, oversized cougar face, half natural and half robotic, with a glowing red eye beneath large white player names and numbers. A fierce, urban-inspired design blending billiards culture, streetwear aesthetics, and futuristic imagery.
